offers_products.reason: Sells natural gas, propane and electricity as energy commodities to customers.

offers_services.reason: Regulated gas distribution, pipeline transmission, and Marlin mobile CNG delivery are utility and transport services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Natural gas and propane distribution to residential customers, e.g. Sharp Energy propane and Florida/Delaware gas utilities.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Commercial and industrial gas customers, local distribution companies on pipelines, and fleets using AutoGas and CNG.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing utility gas and propane service, plus pipeline transportation contracts, bring repeat billing.

cyclical_demand.reason: Heating and energy delivery is essential; customers can't easily postpone gas utility and propane purchases.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent bills for gas and propane deliveries.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from pipelines, distribution networks, trailers and power plants, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Mix of residential, commercial and industrial customers; many households, so not mainly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns gas distribution systems, transmission pipelines, CNG trailer fleet and power plants needing heavy capital investment.
